note: The minister's declaration of 10 August 2026 lists the deployment of a national civil status register tied to a personal identification number as a pillar, and the development and deployment of a civil status digitisation platform as an achievement, without saying what either does or where records are entered; the 54% (2022) to 72% (2025) figure is a share of births registered, not of offices.
